Have you ever tried Egg Coffee before? Honestly I can’t say I wasn’t sceptic if I would like it! Thinking of eggs and coffee together gave me an image I’m better not sharing but when I took my first sip I knew I found something special 🥹
Also NO, it doesn’t taste like egg 😅

What is Egg Coffee? 

The Vietnamese take on this treat makes for a dessert coffee, a silky concoction comprised of a sweet eggy foam floating atop of a cup of 
dark brew. Imagine a tiramisu in beverage form, and you will likely get pretty close to the vibe of a good egg coffee. 

While not everyone may want to or can travel to Vietnam for this so I’ll share an easy recipe that I learnt on how to make it :)
